test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 08 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
A sentence has been given with a blank to be filled with an appropriate word. Choose the correct alternative.

More than 200 eminent Indian Americans attended the reception at the East Room, a venue which has ________ some of the landmark events related to the India-U. S. relationship.
solution:
The correct answer is **witnessed.**** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• “**Witnessed**” means** “see or watch something**.”

 
 
• **Example: ***He witnessed a car accident yesterday.*
 
 
 
• The complete sentence will be, **More than 200 eminent Indian Americans attended the reception at the East Room, a venue which has *witnessed* some of the landmark events related to the India-U. S. relationship.​**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

The meaning and usage of the other words are as follows:

 
• “**Surpassed**” means “**to cross over something”.**

 
 
• **Example**: *This time, the expense for the party surpassed $30,000.*
 
 
 
• “**Rebuffed** means **to get rejected suddenly.**
 
 
• **Example:** *The proposal for the new computer got rebuffed without no particular reason.*
 
 
 
• “**Grounded**” means** ''to restrict somebody or stop them from leaving a place, especially as a punishment''****.**
 
 
• **Example**:* I stayed out till 1 am last night and now I'm grounded for a week.*
